newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms pass on 40,000T of tapioca tenders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms pass on 40,000T of tapioca tenders.

text.p: A South Korean feed grain buyer group, known as the Feed Buying Group, passed on tenders of 40,000 tonnes of tapioca due to high offer prices, traders said on Friday.

They said the passed tender was split into three lots: one for 12,000 tonnes for arrival by May 10, another for 14,000 tonnes for arrival by June 10 and the third for 14,000 tonnes for arrival by July 10 at the western port of Inchon.
The lowest bid was made by Thai STC Tapioca Group Co Ltd at $84.43 a tonne C&F, they said.
